name: The Things Cabinet
thesis: A vivid graphic cabinet makes Raygen's machines, identity, and community into personal objects worth opening.
interaction: Pull any drawer handle to unfold its contents; the other drawers close, keeping the cabinet compact and focused.
why: The two real printers share a working shelf, the avatar lives in a lavender drawer, and Hack Club and Stardance become cherished objects in Raygen's own collection.
